# Lab 23.2: Cross-Region Dataset Replication

## What We Are Going to Do
Add a secondary replica of a dataset in another region, watch the backfill, and switch which region is primary.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a regional dataset with data.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA lab23_rep OPTIONS (location = 'us-central1');

CREATE TABLE lab23_rep.events AS
SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS id, TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01', INTERVAL n MINUTE) AS ts, RAND() * 100 AS value
FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS n;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Add a replica in another region.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER SCHEMA lab23_rep ADD REPLICA `us-east4` OPTIONS (location = 'us-east4');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Watch the backfill.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT schema_name, replica_name, location, replica_primary_assigned, replica_primary_assignment_complete,
       creation_complete, replication_time
FROM `region-us-central1`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_REPLICAS
WHERE schema_name = 'lab23_rep';</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Wait until `creation_complete` is true.

4. **[SQL] Read from the secondary.** Run this with the processing location set to `us-east4`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab23_rep.events;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The secondary is read-only.

5. **[SQL] Promote the secondary.** Run in `us-east4`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER SCHEMA lab23_rep SET OPTIONS (primary_replica = 'us-east4');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `us-east4` is now writable and `us-central1` becomes the read-only secondary.

6. **[SQL] Remove the replica to stop paying for it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER SCHEMA lab23_rep DROP REPLICA IF EXISTS `us-central1`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **[CLI] Check replicas from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --location=us-central1 \
"SELECT replica_name, location, creation_complete FROM \`region-us-central1\`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_REPLICAS WHERE schema_name = 'lab23_rep'"</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Replica | Full copy in another region |
| Secondary | Read-only |
| Promotion | Primary switched by DDL |
| Cost | Storage in both regions plus replication |
